derivative_asset_id.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names an assetId shorter than 16 characters; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_configuration.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names a normalizer configurationSha256 that is not lowercase hex; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_contract.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names a contract other than antares.normalized-text/v1; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_coverage_depth.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original carries coverage nesting 65 objects deep, one past the 64-level bound that keeps it readable inside every envelope; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_coverage_floats_over.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative's coverage is 2500 copies of 1.0: 10 KiB as the Rust reader serializes it (1.0 is written 1.0), over the 8 KiB bound; a reader counting its own shorter spelling would accept it.

derivative_coverage_non_finite.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative's opaque coverage holds 1e999, which no double holds; the Rust reader refuses it (serde_json: number out of range) and no reader may turn it into an infinity.

derivative_coverage_size.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original carries coverage over 8 KiB serialized; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_coverage_type.ant.refusedFor: coverage must be a JSON object
derivative_coverage_type.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original carries coverage that is not a JSON object; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_index_negative_zero.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative's typed u64 segment.index is the literal -0, which the Rust reader decodes as a double, not a u64.

derivative_job_id.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names a jobId outside [A-Za-z0-9_.:-]; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_locator.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names a locator one byte over 2 KiB; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_normalizer.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names a normalizer outside [A-Za-z0-9_.:-]; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_orphan.ant.why: v1.0: a cleaned-text derivative of ev_original appears after unrelated records; a derivative follows its primary's original and source references.

derivative_out_of_order.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's derivatives are not in strictly increasing (jobId, index) order.

derivative_primary_control.ant.refusedFor: primaryEvidenceId must be non-empty with no control characters
derivative_primary_control.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names a primaryEvidenceId with a control character; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_sha256.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names a sha256 that is not lowercase hex; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_text_mismatch.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative's content is not the text its derivation names (textSha256/textByteLength).

derivative_text_sha256.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original names a textSha256 that is not lowercase hex; the Rust Derivation rule refuses it.

derivative_unbound.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative after ev_original names different bytes (another sha256); a derivation binds exactly the original it follows.

derivative_with_original.ant.refusedFor: carries both a derivation and an original
derivative_with_original.ant.why: v1.0: a derivative of ev_original also carries a sourceBlob; a derivative carries no original.

major_version.ant.why: declares format v2.0; a reader of 0.x and 1.x must refuse rather than misread, because a major bump means field meanings or the container framing changed. Valid in every other respect, so rejecting it for any other reason is the wrong pass.

original_blob_asset_id.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's sourceBlob names an assetId shorter than 16 characters; the Rust rule refuses it.

original_blob_file_name.ant.refusedFor: sourceBlob.fileName must be 1..=1024 bytes with no control
original_blob_file_name.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's sourceBlob declares a fileName with a control character; the Rust rule refuses it.

original_blob_media_type.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's sourceBlob declares a mediaType that is not printable ASCII; the Rust rule refuses it.

original_blob_sha256.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's sourceBlob names a sha256 that is not lowercase hex; the Rust rule refuses it.

original_chunk_digest.ant.why: v1.0: chunk 1 of ev_original does not match its own sha256.

original_in_v0.ant.why: declares v0.7 but carries a sourceBlob and original_chunk records, which only v1.0 may: a 0.x reader would drop them silently.

original_interrupted.ant.why: v1.0: another record appears between ev_original's chunks; an original's chunks follow its evidence with nothing in between.

original_missing_chunk.ant.why: v1.0: chunk 1 of ev_original is absent; its original cannot be whole.

original_reordered.ant.why: v1.0: chunks 1 and 2 of ev_original are swapped; chunks are contiguous and in order.

original_source_unbound.ant.why: v1.0: a source reference after ev_original names different bytes (another sha256); a reference binds to exactly the original it follows.

original_whole_digest.ant.why: v1.0: every chunk matches its own sha256, but together they are not the original ev_original's sourceBlob.sha256 declares.

source_reference_asset_id.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's first source reference names an assetId shorter than 16 characters; the Rust rule refuses it.

source_reference_evidence_control.ant.refusedFor: reference.evidenceId must be non-empty with no control
source_reference_evidence_control.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's first source reference names an evidenceId with a control character; the Rust rule refuses it.

source_reference_id.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's first source reference names a referenceId outside [A-Za-z0-9_.:-]; the Rust rule refuses it.

source_reference_source_depth.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's first source reference carries a source nesting 65 objects deep, one past the 64-level bound; the Rust rule refuses it.

source_reference_source_size.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's first source reference carries a source over 16 KiB serialized; the Rust rule refuses it.

source_reference_source_type.ant.refusedFor: reference.source must be a JSON object
source_reference_source_type.ant.why: v1.0: ev_original's first source reference carries a source that is not a JSON object; the Rust rule refuses it.
